name: Under the Tree 2: Hedgerows
storyline:
The evil villain Ugnet is back at it again, and it's up to you to stop him and his horde of Monsters! To defeat him you'll need to fight your way through to recover Ugnet's Bane from the deepest levels of his dungeon.

Battle dozens of unique monsters as you penetrate deeper and deeper into Ugnet's Dungeons, leveling up, learning new Spells, and becoming more powerful in the process.

Find gold, ingredients and items you can trade in four different shops in Luskwood to buy or upgrade Armor, Helmets, Shields, Swords, Scrolls, Potions and Vials.
summary: The sequel to Under The Tree! A first-person grid-based dungeon crawler inspired by the original Wizardry first released on the Apple ][, simplified to suit the screen and controls of the Playdate. Featuring an all-new 3D graphics engine, with dungeon and outdoor areas, quests, puzzles and more!
